B) Seems correct. "With per-machine installation, automatic updates is disabled. This means that to update the Teams app, you must uninstall the current version to update to a newer version. With per-user installation, automatic updates is enabled. For most VDI deployments, we recommend you deploy Teams using per-machine installation. To update to the latest Teams version, start with the uninstall procedure followed by latest Teams version deployment." https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-for-vdi
the real reason B is right is because In a non-persistent VDI setup, user environments are reset to a default state at each logon. This means that software updates or changes need to be applied to the base VM image, so they are present in each new user session.
B: For a non-persistent setup, the Teams desktop app must be installed per-machine to the golden image. This ensures an efficient launch of the Teams app during a user session. Answer is correct, option B. In VDI clients you can deploy Teams per machine or per user, and in non-persistent setup as mentioned below, it means that is a per machine installation: "All company users use the Microsoft Teams desktop client in non-persistent virtual desktops." Considering that, by default automatic updates are disable, the only option is you must uninstall and re-install, for that reason option B is correct.
B is correct Install or update the Teams desktop app on VDI You can deploy the Teams desktop app for VDI using a per-machine installation or per-user installation using the MSI package. Deciding on which approach to use depends on whether you use a persistent or non-persistent setup and the associated functionality needs of your organization. For a dedicated persistent setup, either approach would work. However, for a non-persistent setup, Teams requires a per-machine installation in order to work efficiently. See the Non-persistent setup section. With per-machine installation, automatic updates are disabled. This means that to update the Teams app, you must uninstall the current version to update to a newer version. With per-user installation, automatic updates are enabled. For most VDI deployments, we recommend you deploy Teams using per-machine installation. I asked this from chat gpt.. D. Microsoft Teams Call Quality Dashboard. To confirm that Quality of Service (QoS) is being applied at the branch offices, you can use the Microsoft Teams Call Quality Dashboard. This dashboard provides an overview of call quality across the organization and can help you identify if there are any issues with call quality for specific users or locations. In the Call Quality Dashboard, you can view the quality of individual calls, including the MOS (Mean Opinion Score) value, network metrics such as packet loss, and the DSCP value of the call traffic. The DSCP value should correspond to the QoS policy you have configured for Microsoft Teams traffic. The Microsoft Teams Device Usage Report provides information about the devices that are being used to access Microsoft Teams but does not provide information about QoS. The Microsoft Network Monitor and Network Testing Companion are not tools that are commonly used to troubleshoot QoS issues in Microsoft Teams.
To confirm that Quality of Service (QoS) is being applied at the branch offices, you should use network monitoring tools such as Microsoft Message Analyzer or Wireshark. These tools can help you analyze the network traffic and identify if the QoS policies are being applied to the Microsoft Teams traffic. You can look for the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value of the Microsoft Teams traffic to confirm if it is being marked correctly. The DSCP value should correspond to the QoS policy you have configured for Microsoft Teams traffic. Additionally, you can also check the Quality of Service (QoS) reports in Microsoft Teams admin center to see if there are any issues reported with call quality for the branch offices.

To meet the security requirement of retaining files used in personal chats or team collaborations for a minimum of one year, you should apply a retention policy to both Teams chat and Teams channel messages. Teams chat: Retention policies can be applied to individual conversations or entire chat history in Teams, so that any files shared in personal chats will be retained for the required time period. Teams channel messages: Retention policies can be applied to entire channel conversations, so that any files shared in team collaborations will be retained for the required time period. It's worth noting that retention policies are not applicable for OneDrive accounts and SharePoint sites, those are used for file storage and management, retention policies are applied to messaging platforms (email, chat, etc) and the content stored in them.

  • BChange the coexistence mode to Teams only.
  • CEnsure that all users have both Microsoft Skype for Business and Microsoft Teams installed and are signed in to both applications.Correct answer
  • DChange the coexistence mode to Skype for Business with Teams collaboration.
Open source page
Community discussion 9
Right answer In this coexistence mode, called Islands, each of the client applications operates as a separate island. Skype for Business talks to Skype for Business, and Teams talks to Teams. Users are expected to run both clients at all times and can communicate natively in the client from which the communication was started
n Islands mode, chat routing is split — Teams chats go only to Teams, Skype chats go only to Skype — so users will miss messages unless they constantly monitor both apps. Simply having both apps installed and signed in (C) is not enough — the service decides where each message goes, and it won’t deliver it to both. Skype for Business with Teams collaboration mode forces all chats and calls to Skype for Business for everyone, ensuring no missed chats during migration, while still allowing Teams for things like meetings and channel collaboration. Microsoft’s own migration guidance advises switching to this mode during the transition to avoid missed communications.
B is the best option as changing the coexistence mode to Teams only ensures all users are using Teams as the single platform for collaboration, preventing any missed chat messages between users.

In this case, you can achieve this goal by using Microsoft 365 or Azure Active Directory policies. One possible solution could involve creating a Teams meeting policy that applies specifically to guest users and restricts their ability to use cameras. You can then assign this policy to guest users in Azure Active Directory.

                                                  Case study - Overview - Company Information - ADatum Corporation is an energy company that has offices across North America and 3,000 employees. Physical Locations - ADatum has the offices shown in the following table. Existing Environment - Network Infrastructure - The office in Calgary has a 1-Gbps internet circuit. The offices in San Diego and New York have 100-Mbps internet circuits. The field site in Edmonton has a 3-Mbps internet circuit. Departments - ADatum has the following departments: • Information technology (IT) • Project management • Marketing Microsoft 365 and Tenants Environment ADatum recently purchased a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that has the Microsoft Teams Domestic Calling Plan add-on. All users are assigned Microsoft 365 E5 and Microsoft Teams Domestic Calling Plan licenses and Calling Plans is deployed. Azure AD has the default Cross-tenant access settings configured. The Teams policies settings are configured as shown in the following exhibit. The Teams client is deployed to a non-persistent Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) used by the project management department. Allow guest access in Teams is set to Off. The Microsoft Viva Connections app is deployed to all users. Problem Statements - ADatum identifies the following issues: • An executive at the San Diego office reports that video drops during Teams meetings. • The Edmonton field site has limited bandwidth, and users report poor audio during Teams calls and meetings. • Users in the project management department report that they cannot give or take control during Teams calls and meetings while sharing their VDI desktop. Planned Changes - ADatum plans to implement the following changes: • Configure the media bit rate settings for the users at the Edmonton field site.                                                                                                                             The **global app permission policy** and the **global app setup policy** in Microsoft Teams serve different purposes: - **Global App Permission Policy**: This policy controls what apps are available to users. By modifying this policy, you can specify which apps (including third-party and custom apps) users are allowed to install and interact with in Microsoft Teams. If an app is not included in this policy, users won't be able to see it or use it. - **Global App Setup Policy**: This policy controls which apps are pinned to the app bar in Teams and in what order they appear. By modifying this policy, you can customize the user's navigation experience in Teams by pinning specific apps to the app bar. In summary, the app permission policy controls **what apps users can use**, while the app setup policy controls **how apps are displayed** to users in Teams.

What are two ways to block guest access to the R&D_Projects team? Each correct answer presents a complete solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

                                                                                                                                              • AApply a sensitivity label to the R&D_Projects team.Correct answer
                                                                                                                                              • BFrom Azure PowerShell, run the New-AzureADObjectSetting cmdlet.Correct answer
                                                                                                                                              • CConfigure a Microsoft 365 group expiration policy.
                                                                                                                                              • DFrom the Microsoft Teams admin center, disable guest access.
                                                                                                                                              • EFrom the Microsoft 365 admin center, disable guest access.
                                                                                                                                              Open source page
                                                                                                                                              Community discussion 10
                                                                                                                                              100% correct answer is A & B.
                                                                                                                                              Answer is A & B - Method 1: Apply a Sensitivity Label to the R&D_Projects Team A. Apply a sensitivity label to the R&D_Projects team. Sensitivity labels can be used to apply specific settings to Microsoft 365 groups and Teams, including controlling guest access. Method 2: Use Azure AD Settings via PowerShell B. From Azure PowerShell, run the New-AzureADObjectSetting cmdlet. Using Azure AD Object Settings, you can configure specific settings for individual groups. The New-AzureADObjectSetting cmdlet can be used to set policies that control guest access for a particular group.
                                                                                                                                              **D. From the Microsoft Teams admin center, disable guest access.** In the Microsoft Teams admin center, you can manage guest access on a per-team basis. You can go to the settings of the R&D_Projects team and disable guest access. This will prevent guest users from being invited to the R&D_Projects team, but they can still be invited to other teams where guest access is enabled. Please note that options B, C, and E are not correct in this context: - **B.** The `New-AzureADObjectSetting` cmdlet in Azure PowerShell is not used for managing guest access to specific teams. - **C.** A Microsoft 365 group expiration policy is used for managing the lifecycle of groups and not for controlling guest access. - **E.** Disabling guest access from the Microsoft 365 admin center would block guest access to all teams, not just the R&D_Projects team. This would contradict the requirement that guest users must be able to be invited to other teams.

                                                                                                                                              Answer is Yes. A channel will be linked as a subfolder when a team is created from within sharepoint site.
                                                                                                                                              By using the "Add Microsoft Teams" link from the Sales SharePoint Online modern team site, you can connect the site to a Microsoft Team. When a SharePoint site is linked to a Microsoft Team: Integration with Teams: The content from the Sales SharePoint document library becomes accessible from the "Files" tab in Microsoft Teams. Folder Creation for Channels: When a new channel is added in the connected Microsoft Team, a corresponding folder is automatically created in the Documents library of the SharePoint site (in this case, the Sales site). This functionality ensures the required synchronization between SharePoint and Team

                                                                                                                                                                  Correct : When you assign a policy to a group, you specify a ranking for the group assignment. This ranking is used to determine which policy a user should inherit as their effective policy if the user is a member of two or more groups and each group is assigned a policy of the same type. The group assignment ranking is relative to other group assignments of the same type. For example, if you're assigning a calling policy to two groups, set the ranking of one assignment to 1 and the other to 2, with 1 being the highest ranking. The group assignment ranking indicates which group membership is more important or more relevant than other group memberships regarding inheritance. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/assign-policies-users-and-groups#precedence-rules
                                                                                                                                                                  Additional support here: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/assign-policies-users-and-groups#precedence-rule
                                                                                                                                                                  yes rank1

                                                                                                                                                                                Your company is releasing a Request for Proposal (RFP) and is collaborating with four vendors. Each vendor must communicate with the company, but the vendors must NOT be able to communicate with each other in channel posts. The company must communicate internally about vendor specifics without the vendors having access to these communications. You need to create teams and channels in Microsoft Teams to support the communication requirements. The solution must minimize the number of teams. What should you do?

                                                                                                                                                                                • ACreate one team that has one private channel per vendor. Use the General channel for internal communications.
                                                                                                                                                                                • BCreate two teams per vendor. Use one team per vendor for internal communications.
                                                                                                                                                                                • CCreate one team per vendor. Use a private channel for internal communications.Correct answer
                                                                                                                                                                                • DCreate one team that has two private channels per vendor. Use one of the private channels per vendor for internal communications.
                                                                                                                                                                                Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                Community discussion 10
                                                                                                                                                                                Correct is C. Both A and D are wrong, because if there is only one team for all vendors, all vendors will necessarily have access to the Generel channel and can communicate to each other in the General channel, which is not what we want. B is too many teams, which also is not what we want to achieve.
                                                                                                                                                                                The solution must minimize the number of teams. A. Create one team that has one private channel per vendor. Use the General channel for internal communications. Here’s why: Creating one team with a private channel for each vendor ensures that vendors cannot communicate with each other in channel posts, as private channels are only accessible to the members added to them. Using the General channel for internal communications allows the company to discuss vendor specifics without the vendors having access to these communications, as vendors would not be members of the General channel. This solution also minimizes the number of teams, as only one team is created.

You need to create the call queues shown in the following table. Which routing method should you configure for each call queue? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Hot Area:

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                                  Community discussion 2
                                                                                                                                                                                                  Attendant routing rings all agents in the queue at the same time. The first call agent to pick up the call gets the call. Serial routing rings all call agents one by one in the order specified in the Call agents list. If an agent dismisses or does not pick up a call, the call will ring the next agent and will try all agents until it is picked up or times out. Round robin balances the routing of incoming calls so that each call agent gets the same number of calls from the queue. This may be desirable in an inbound sales environment to assure equal opportunity among all the call agents. Longest idle routes each call to the agent who has been idle the longest time. An agent is considered idle if their presence state is Available or if their presence state has been Away for less than 10 minutes. Agents whose presence state has been Away for more than 10 minutes are not considered idle and will not be eligible to receive calls until they change their presence to Available.
                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer is Correct Attendant routing is first call in the queue rings all agents at the same time (Simultaneously) Round robin - routing of incoming calls is balance so that each call gets the same numbers of call from the queue.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          As industry best practices, create a custom policy to override an existing default global policy rather than editing or modifying the defaults.                                                                                                                                                                                                           Best practice is to create a new policy when deviating from the Global policy (only applying settings there if it really should affect ALL users, and otherwise leaving it at default). Call Park Policies: 0 No call park policies are necessary for the specified requirements.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             To acquire a dedicated Microsoft dial-in bridge number from either the 431 or 343 area codes in Canada, you can follow these steps: • Log in to your Microsoft Teams admin center. • Click on "Voice" from the left-hand menu, then click on "Phone numbers." • Click on "Add" to add a new phone number. • Select "Canada" as the country/region, Number type as Dedicated conference Bridge(toll) and then choose either the 431 or 343 area code. • Choose "Microsoft" as a operator • Enter the number of phone numbers you want to acquire and click "Add." • Review the order details and click "Submit order."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Option B https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/qos-in-teams "Using port-based tagging, your network's router examines an incoming packet, and if the packet arrived using a certain port or range of ports, it identifies it as a certain media type and puts it in the queue for that type, adding a predetermined DSCP mark to the IP Packet header so other devices can recognize its traffic type and give it priority in their queue."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                On exam 31/03/2023 B. In Group Policy Management, create a Group Policy setting to specify DSCP values. By setting the Insert Quality of Service (QoS) markers for real-time media traffic as Enabled in the Microsoft Teams admin center, you allow Teams to automatically assign audio and video data packets with a Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value. To ensure that computers prioritize real-time media traffic, you will need to create a Group Policy setting to specify the DSCP values. This will ensure that real-time media traffic has priority over other network activities. Setting the media port range and media bit rate is not necessary to prioritize audio and video during Teams meetings. Creating a network roaming policy in the Teams PowerShell module is not relevant to this scenario.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Address Validation: To ensure accurate emergency response, Microsoft Teams requires precise location information. Latitude and Longitude: These coordinates provide the most accurate way to pinpoint a location on the map, enabling emergency services to locate callers quickly and efficiently. Steps to Validate an Emergency Address: Access the Microsoft Teams admin center. Navigate to Locations > Emergency addresses. Click Add to create a new address. Enter the address details, including street address, city, state/province, and country/region. Crucially, provide the latitude and longitude of the address. You can typically find these coordinates using online mapping tools or GPS devices. Click Save.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The "Calls ring me" option was part of older Teams settings, but in newer versions, Microsoft has changed the wording. Instead of "Calls ring me," you now have settings under Call handling and forwarding that control how calls behave. Also, Busy on busy during calls lets you configure how incoming calls are handled when a user is already in a call or conference or has a call placed on hold. New or incoming calls can be rejected with a busy signal or can be routed accordingly to the user's unanswered settings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   D Here's why: Simultaneous ring: This feature allows users to receive incoming calls on multiple devices simultaneously. It also enables users to change the destination of forwarded calls by selecting a different device from the list of ringing devices. Other options: Busy on busy when in a call: This setting determines how incoming calls are handled when the user is already in a call. It doesn't affect the ability to change the destination of forwarded calls. Enterprise Voice: This add-on license enables users to make and receive phone calls from Teams using traditional phone numbers. It doesn't directly impact the ability to change the destination of forwarded calls. Outbound calling: This feature allows users to make calls to external phone numbers from Teams. It also doesn't affect the ability to change the destination of forwarded calls.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Question 62 Answer: D, E

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams. All users are assigned an Microsoft 365 E3 license. You need to ensure that the users can join scheduled meetings by dialing a toll-free phone number. Which two add-on licenses should you assign to the users? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • AMicrosoft Teams Rooms Pro
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • BMicrosoft Teams Domestic Calling Plan
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • CMicrosoft Teams Shared Devices
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • DCommunication CreditsCorrect answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • EMicrosoft 365 Audio ConferencingCorrect answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Community discussion 2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      This is the same question as Topic2 Question #61
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      D. Communication Credits: Communication Credits are used for paying toll-free and premium call charges associated with Audio Conferencing in Microsoft Teams. E. Microsoft 365 Audio Conferencing: Microsoft 365 Audio Conferencing allows users to dial in to Teams meetings using a phone, and it includes toll-free numbers. Option B (Microsoft Teams Domestic Calling Plan) is not directly related to toll-free numbers. Calling Plans are typically associated with providing domestic calling capabilities, but toll-free numbers usually require Communication Credits or Audio Conferencing licenses. Options A (Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro) and C (Microsoft Teams Shared Devices) are related to hardware and devices for meeting rooms but are not required for users to join meetings by dialing toll-free numbers. Therefore, the correct answers are D (Communication Credits) and E (Microsoft 365 Audio Conferencing).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          B and E Network roaming policy lets you enforce different bandwidth restrictions depending on the user's network location (so the limits only apply when in the branch office). General Overview - Wingtip Toys is a manufacturing company that has 5,000 users, and locations across North America and Europe. Departments - The company has the following departments: • IT • Sales • Security • Customer support • Human resources (HR) • Research and development (R&D) Microsoft Office 365 Environment All users are assigned a Microsoft 365 E5 license and are enabled for Microsoft Teams Phone. Users in the R&D department are assigned a Teams Premium license. Requirements - Call Handling Requirements - Wingtip Toys identifies the following call handling requirements: • Inbound calls to the main telephone number of Wingtip Toys must be routed to the correct department by using an auto attendant. • During holiday periods, the auto attendant must perform the following actions: • Route customer support calls to the customer support department. • Play a recorded message for calls to all the other departments, and then disconnect the call. Meeting Requirements - Wingtip Toys identifies the following meeting requirements: • Meetings that include users from the R&D department must have a watermark applied to screen sharing sessions. • Once a quarter, the CEO of Wingtip Toys must host a live, online event that is attended by all users. Governance Requirements - Wingtip Toys identifies the following governance requirements: • New teams must meet the following requirements: • The Team type setting must be set to Private. • Users must be able to send emails to team channels. • Team members must be prevented from deleting messages from team channels. • Each team name must be validated against a list of blocked team names. • Each team name must contain a prefix of GRP and the department name as a suffix. • Team channels must include a pinned tab that displays the Wingtip Toys website. • When a user creates a team, the team picture must be the logo of the user's department. • The department manager of the user that creates the team must be assigned the Owner role for the team. • The use of animated GIFs must be prevented in team channels. Collaboration Requirements - Wingtip Toys identifies the following collaboration requirements: • Fabrikam users must be able to join team channels hosted by Wingtip Toys. • Wingtip Toys users must be prevented from joining team channels hosted by Fabrikam. Monitoring Requirements - A notification must be sent to users in the IT department when a Teams Rooms system goes offline. Pilot Project Requirements - Wingtip Toys is currently evaluating third-party call center apps that integrate with Teams. The security department mandates that all third-party apps be reviewed by a qualified analyst and comply with industry-standard frameworks. User Issues - Wingtip Toys users report audio and video issues when accessing Teams meetings by using a web browser. Business Requirements - Wingtip Toys identifies the following business requirements: • Follow the principle of least privilege. • Minimize administrative effort. • Minimize costs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         This is correct!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         yes, that's right.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Network trace is showing TCP traffic: "TCP is considered a failback transport and not the primary transport you want for real-time media. The reason it’s a failback transport is due to the stateful nature of TCP. For example, if a call is made on a latent network and media packets are delayed, then packets from a few seconds ago—which are no longer useful—compete for bandwidth to get to the receiver, which can make a bad situation worse. This makes the audio healer stitch and stretch audio, resulting in audible artifacts, often in the form of jitter." Source: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/MicrosoftTeams/quality-of-experience-review-guide#quality-investigations

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Cualquier plataforma que haga uso de telefonía IP necesita un rango de puertos UDP amplio: estas plataformas como Teams, están pensadas para un rango potencial de llamadas y usuarios bastante elevado, y cada llamada (sesión de audio, video,..) utiliza varios puertos UDP. De ahí que requieran un rango muy amplio.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Look at DstPort: it says port 443, it is using TCP port. UDP ports must be used for audio and video. UDP guarantees quality communication. Example: if the road of my voice or my image has a lot of traffic, it will take a long time to get from source to destination: the voice will not be heard in real time, it arrives late, it is cut, and the image freezes, it is blocked: this is TCP: the car goes slow on the road if there is traffic. The UDP port sends the information always, it does not wait for the road to be clear. Imagine that it is an ambulance: it always has priority they must let them pass - this is UDP. It is very common for FWs to block UDP traffic, because a very wide open range of ports is needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        I can see people asking about how people know this is TCP and not UDP.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         How can we know this isn't a signaling packet? If it's a voice packet, I agree it should be UDP instead of TCP. But signaling is always TCP.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        udp is the protocol used for real-time communications - so as stated by OrwellMB if you can see a problem with the udp protocol as in this example where TCP is employed meaning udp is not which implies a problem with the udp protocol
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TCP: Sends a packet > waits for an acknowledgment from destination > sends the next packet (also known as 3 way handshake) | No packets are lost | Slow and not handy in real time traffic | e.g. Emails use TCP UDP: Sends all packets in a single go | Doesnt care about acknowledgment hence sometimes looses few packets on the way | Ideal for real time traffic like audio and video calls. The fact that TCP is present in mentioned question, indicates that there is no real time traffic exchange between source and destination. Hence the UDP traffic (or real time traffic) is limited.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Good, poor, and unclassified calls A call is categorized either as good, poor, or unclassified. Let's take a moment to talk about each one in more detail. Good or poor: A good or poor call consists of a call that contains a complete set of service metrics, for which a full QoE report was generated and received by the service. Determining whether a stream is good or poor is described earlier in this guide. Unclassified: An unclassified stream doesn't contain a full set of service metrics. These can be short calls—usually less than 60 seconds—where averages couldn't be computed and a QoE report wasn't generated. The most common reason for calls to be unclassified is that there was little to no packet utilization. An example of this would be a participant who joins a meeting on mute and never speaks. The participant is receiving, but not transmitting, media. Without media being transmitted, there won't be any metrics available for CQD to use to classify the endpoint's outbound media stream.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            You have a Microsoft Office 365 subscription that contains a user named User1. You need to ensure that User1 can view Usage reports in the Microsoft Teams admin center. The solution must use the principle of least privilege. Which role should you assign to User1?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • AUsage Summary Reports ReaderCorrect answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • BSkype for Business administrator
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • CGlobal Reader

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Community discussion 11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            tested the answer is C. Global Reader
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Usage Summary Reports Reader: This role grants access to aggregated, tenant-level Teams usage data. This means User1 can see overall trends and usage statistics but cannot access individual user or team data. This aligns with the principle of least privilege by providing the minimum necessary access to fulfill User1's task of viewing usage reports. Global Reader grants read-only access to almost all aspects of Microsoft 365, including user information, licenses, and security settings. It's far too much access for simply viewing Teams usage reports.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            According https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/microsoftteams/teams-analytics-and-reports/teams-reporting-reference#how-to-access-the-reports
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Ans : A To allow User1 to view usage reports in the Microsoft Teams admin center while following the principle of least privilege, the Usage Summary Reports Reader role is the most appropriate. This role provides access to view usage reports across Microsoft 365, including Teams, without granting additional administrative permissions. Global Reader: While the Global Reader role can view all administrative features across Microsoft 365, it grants broader read-only access than necessary, violating the principle of least privileg
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Please compare Global Reader and Usage Summary Reports Reader in the admin portal. Teams or Skype for Business administrator. Global reader (only tenant-level aggregate and no per-user or team data).

Planned Changes - ADatum plans to implement the following changes: • Configure the media bit rate settings for the users at the Edmonton field site. The solution must follow the principle of least privilege. Which role should you assign to User1?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ATeams Communications Support Engineer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • BTeams Communications Support Specialist
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • CTeams Administrator
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • DTeams Telephony Administrator
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ETeams Communications AdministratorCorrect answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Community discussion 3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  E — Teams Communications Administrator
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Teams Communications Support Engineer ✅ This role has access to advanced features in the Call Quality Dashboard (CQD), including: Creating and editing Power BI reports with CQD data Viewing IP and MAC addresses Uploading office location data for location-based insights Teams Communications Support Specialist cannot create Power BI reports, view IP/MAC addresses, or upload location data. Teams Administrator This role has full admin access to Teams, including settings, policies, and teams management — but not full CQD reporting rights like viewing MAC/IP or uploading location data. Teams Telephony Administrator This role focuses on PSTN, Calling Plans, and Phone System settings — not CQD analytics. Teams Communications Administrator While this role can manage meeting and calling features and some CQD usage, it does not grant permissions to view or edit Power BI CQD data or upload office location mappings.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A. Teams Communications Support Engineer ====> cant upload locations B. Teams Communications Support Specialist ====> no access to IP C. Teams Administrator D. Teams Telephony Administrator ===> no access to CQD E. Teams Communications Administrator

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Question 45 Answer: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    You have a Teams deployment. You deploy the new Teams client to users. The users report that a third-party Teams store app fails to load. You need to identity the cause of the issue. What should you do?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • AEnable Extended diagnostics data for the new Teams client.Correct answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • BRun the Microsoft 365 network connectivity test tool.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • CRun the Teams client in a browser and open the developer tools.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • DRun sfc.exe as an administrator.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Community discussion 2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I would not change it to A. Microsoft’s Teams app troubleshooting guidance says to use Developer Tools to troubleshoot app-load problems and inspect the Network tab plus the error response details when a Teams app fails to load. That is the direct way to identify the cause of a third-party Teams app loading failure. Why A is tempting but not best: Extended diagnostics data/logging is about sending richer diagnostic data to Microsoft and collecting more logs; Microsoft specifically calls out turning on extended logging for VDI before reproducing an issue and collecting logs. That is useful for deeper telemetry/support, but it is not the primary step Microsoft points to for finding why an app fails to load. So lock in: C.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Enable Extended diagnostics data for the new Teams client. Enabling extended diagnostics data provides detailed logs and information about the Teams client's operation, including app loading processes. This allows for a thorough investigation into why the third-party app is failing to load.

As a result, these questions do not appear on the Review Screen. You have a Teams deployment. A user cannot sign in to Teams. You need to run self-help diagnostics to troubleshoot the issue. Solution: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, you select Service health. Does this meet the goal?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • AYes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • BNoCorrect answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Community discussion 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Service Health in Microsoft 365 admin center shows the operational status of Microsoft services (Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, etc.). It lists current outages, incidents, or advisories. This is passive — it doesn’t run diagnostics. If sign-in fails because of a global outage, Service health would alert you. But if the issue is user-specific (credentials, device/network), Service Health won’t help — you need actual diagnostics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        You have a Teams deployment. You start a meeting and enable the following settings: • Enable Green room • Provide CART Captions • Enable end-to-end Encryption • Anonymous users can join the meeting What feature is no longer available during the meeting?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ARaise hand
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Breactions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Cscreen sharing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Dbreakout roomsCorrect answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Open source page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Community discussion 2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        When you enable end-to-end encryption (E2EE) in Microsoft Teams meetings, several features become unavailable in order to maintain full encryption protection. According to Microsoft documentation, the following are restricted during E2EE: Meeting recording Transcription and captions (other than CART captions) Breakout rooms Together mode Large gallery Call transfer and consult features
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Breakout rooms are not supported if you enable end to end encryption.
